$comment: Derived-Debug structs the secret-debug guard (scripts/lib/secret-debug.mjs) allows
although a field is named like a credential. Keys are `<path>:<Type>.<field>`; every
entry says why the value is not a secret. Add one only for a value that is public by
construction. A credential gets a hand-written `impl fmt::Debug` instead (ADR 0155).

allowed.crates/storage/src/lib.rs:StoredAcmeChal: The RFC 8555 http-01/dns-01 challenge token: the CA publishes it and the ACME client serves it in the clear at /.well-known/acme-challenge/<token>. The account-key-bound key authorization is the proof, and it is not on this struct.
allowed.crates/vault-item-types/src/schema.rs:Na: A schema field: the NAME of the item field that becomes line one (`secret: null` projects an empty line). Item-type manifests are public definitions (ADR 0087); no value is held.
